title: Current constellation chart bridge

scope.artChange: Extended the interactive constellation chart to render the additive Cyg/Gem/Leo/Cru figure set and their current IAU boundary rings; kept chart lines explicitly illustrative.

limitations: The four new figures use catalog anchor stars as an explanatory route, not an astronomical boundary reconstruction.
Beta target remains open: 24 hero stars, 12 constellations, 24 rights-cleared nebulae, browser/performance/lifecycle gates.
